remarks: THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST IN MARVIN RIDGE. PLEASE SEND HIGHEST AND BEST OFFER BY MONDAY, 3/23 BY 5:00PM. Welcome to this beautifully maintained home located in a desirable neighborhood near the New Canaan border and the sought-after Thayer Pond community. This inviting property offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Step inside to discover a bright and spacious floor plan featuring a two-story entrance, hardwood floors, beams, large windows, and an updated kitchen and baths. The kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, offering granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry and a large, center island. It opens seamlessly to the family room, where a brick fireplace creates a warm and inviting living space. A stunning great room with cathedral wood ceiling, large brick fireplace and French doors overlooks the newer Azek mahogany decks and expansive yard, creating the perfect space for relaxing or hosting summer gatherings. The large yard provides plenty of room for sports, gardening, and outdoor entertaining. The first-floor primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a beautiful new en-suite bath, with double sinks, stand-alone tub, shower and a large, walk-in closet. Upstairs you will find 3 additional large bedrooms, including one with its own an en-suite bath, along with a separate newly renovated full bath with double sinks and a tub with shower.
